description: This Java class defines the ShareAccountCharge entity, representing charges associated with share accounts in the Fineract system. It includes fields for charge details, status, and methods for managing charge payments, waivers, and calculations.

classes.name: ShareAccountCharge
classes.description: Entity representing a charge applied to a share account, including methods for managing charge status, payments, waivers, and calculations.

methods.name: createNewWithoutShareAccount
methods.description: Creates a new ShareAccountCharge instance without associating it with a specific share account.

methods.name: markAsFullyPaid
methods.description: Marks the charge as fully paid, setting paid amount to total and outstanding to zero.

methods.name: resetToOriginal
methods.description: Resets the charge's financial fields to their original state.

methods.name: undoPayment
methods.description: Reverses a payment, updating paid and outstanding amounts accordingly.

methods.name: waive
methods.description: Waives the charge amount, updating waived and outstanding amounts.

methods.name: undoWaiver
methods.description: Reverses a waiver, restoring the charge's amounts.

methods.name: pay
methods.description: Records a payment towards the charge, updating paid and outstanding amounts.

methods.name: calculateAmountOutstanding
methods.description: Calculates the remaining amount outstanding for the charge.

methods.name: percentageOf
methods.description: Calculates a percentage of a given value.

methods.name: percentageOrAmount
methods.description: Returns the amount or percentage associated with the charge.

methods.name: amoutOutstanding
methods.description: Returns the current outstanding amount.

methods.name: isNotFullyPaid
methods.description: Checks if the charge is not fully paid.

methods.name: isPaid
methods.description: Checks if the charge is fully paid.

methods.name: isWaived
methods.description: Checks if the charge has been waived.

methods.name: isPaidOrPartiallyPaid
methods.description: Checks if the charge has been paid or partially paid.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Retrieves the total amount of the charge in a specified currency.

methods.name: getAmountPaid
methods.description: Retrieves the amount paid towards the charge.

methods.name: getAmountWaived
methods.description: Retrieves the waived amount.

methods.name: getAmountWrittenOff
methods.description: Retrieves the written-off amount.

methods.name: getAmountOutstanding
methods.description: Retrieves the current outstanding amount.

methods.name: updatePaidAmountBy
methods.description: Updates the paid amount by a specified increment.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the charge.

methods.name: currencyCode
methods.description: Returns the currency code of the charge.

methods.name: getCharge
methods.description: Returns the Charge object associated with this charge.

methods.name: shareAccount
methods.description: Returns the ShareAccount associated with this charge.

methods.name: isShareAccountActivation
methods.description: Checks if the charge is for share account activation.

methods.name: isShareAccountClosure
methods.description: Checks if the charge is for share account closure.

methods.name: hasCurrencyCodeOf
methods.description: Checks if the charge's currency code matches a given code.

methods.name: updateWithdralFeeAmount
methods.description: Updates the outstanding amount based on withdrawal fee calculation.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the charge is active.

methods.name: isNotActive
methods.description: Checks if the charge is not active.

methods.name: getChargeId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the associated charge.

methods.name: isSharesPurchaseCharge
methods.description: Checks if the charge is for share purchase.

methods.name: isSharesRedeemCharge
methods.description: Checks if the charge is for share redemption.

methods.name: getChargeTimeType
methods.description: Returns the charge time type as an integer.

methods.name: deriveChargeAmount
methods.description: Calculates the charge amount based on transaction and charge calculation type.

methods.name: updateChargeDetailsForAdditionalSharesRequest
methods.description: Updates charge details for additional share requests.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Sets the active status of the charge.
